name: cold
description: The visitor lands on the application directly. Nothing was prepared.

name: prepared
description: The marketing page prepared this app on intent; the visitor clicked through in the same document.

name: cancelled
description: Preparation began and was abandoned — the visitor scrolled away or the tab was hidden.

name: repeat
description: A second activation in the same document: another island appears, or the shell reveals another view.

name: stale
description: A release is published between preparation and the click.
